描述_EN: 220), an endless source for the antiquarian interests of the seventeenth century. although this screen does not show the standard scene of a painter rendering her image, it is interesting to note that a single horse is depicted standing beneath a willow tree in the center. many such scenes are thought to allude to the richness of court life during the han dynasty (206 b.c.–a.d. some also illustrate the tragic story of the beautiful wang zhaojun, who was sent by emperor yuan (reigned 75–33 b.c.) to marry a xiongnu chieftain in an attempt to pacify these powerful barbarians. in china, images of a romanticized world, where elegant women spend their time dancing and playing music, often have historical overtones. this animal may represent wang’s imminent departure from her safe, and luxurious, life at the court to the less sheltered world of the grasslands in the distant north.
描述_ZN: 220），这是十七世纪古物学兴趣的一个无尽的来源。 虽然这幅屏风没有显示画家渲染她的形象的标准场景，但值得注意的是，一匹马被描绘在中央的柳树下。 许多这样的场景被认为是暗指汉代（公元前206年-公元后）丰富的宫廷生活。 有些还说明了美丽的王昭君的悲剧故事，她被元朝皇帝（公元前75-33年在位）派去与一个匈奴酋长结婚，试图安抚这些强大的蛮族。 在中国，一个浪漫的世界的形象，优雅的女人花时间跳舞和玩音乐，往往有历史的色彩。 这种动物可能代表王氏即将离开她在宫廷的安全和奢华的生活，前往遥远的北方草原这个不太受保护的世界。
